meaning: انحراف از حالت معمول؛ مورد غیرعادی

examples.english: The sudden drop in sales was an aberration in an otherwise steady quarter.
examples.persian: کاهش ناگهانی فروش یک انحراف از حالت معمول در فصلی که در غیر این صورت ثابت بود، به شمار می‌رفت.

miniContext: The sudden drop in sales was an aberration in an otherwise steady quarter.

examples.english: Most readers abhor cruelty toward animals in any story.
examples.persian: بیشتر خوانندگان از بی‌رحمی نسبت به حیوانات در هر داستانی بیزارند.

miniContext: Most readers abhor cruelty toward animals in any story.

examples.english: The prisoners lived in abject poverty, with barely enough food to survive.
examples.persian: زندانیان در فقری بسیار پست و اسفناک زندگی می‌کردند و به‌سختی غذای کافی برای زنده ماندن داشتند.

miniContext: The prisoners lived in abject poverty, with barely enough food to survive.

examples.english: The professor's lecture on quantum field theory was too abstruse for most undergraduates.
examples.persian: سخنرانی استاد درباره نظریه میدان کوانتومی برای بیشتر دانشجویان کارشناسی بسیار دشوارفهم و پیچیده بود.

miniContext: The professor's lecture on quantum field theory was too abstruse for most undergraduates.

examples.english: After hours of arguing, she finally acquiesced to her brother's plan.
examples.persian: پس از ساعت‌ها بحث، او در نهایت با اکراه نقشه برادرش را پذیرفت.

miniContext: After hours of arguing, she finally acquiesced to her brother's plan.

examples.english: The divorce turned acrimonious once the couple began fighting over custody.
examples.persian: طلاق پس از آنکه زوجین بر سر حضانت فرزند با هم درگیر شدند، تلخ و خصمانه شد.

miniContext: The divorce turned acrimonious once the couple began fighting over custody.

examples.english: The coach was adamant that the team practice every single morning.
examples.persian: مربی مصمم و سازش‌ناپذیر بود که تیم هر روز صبح تمرین کند.

miniContext: The coach was adamant that the team practice every single morning.

examples.english: The teacher admonished the students for talking during the exam.
examples.persian: معلم دانش‌آموزان را به خاطر صحبت کردن در طول امتحان توبیخ کرد.

miniContext: The teacher admonished the students for talking during the exam.

examples.english: The architect chose white marble for purely aesthetic reasons.
examples.persian: معمار مرمر سفید را صرفاً به دلایل زیبایی‌شناختی انتخاب کرد.

miniContext: The architect chose white marble for purely aesthetic reasons.

examples.english: The new manager is affable and always greets employees by name.
examples.persian: مدیر جدید خوش‌برخورد است و همیشه کارمندان را با نام صدا می‌زند.

miniContext: The new manager is affable and always greets employees by name.

examples.english: She agreed to help with alacrity, dropping everything else she was doing.
examples.persian: او با چابکی و اشتیاق پذیرفت که کمک کند و هر کار دیگری را که انجام می‌داد رها کرد.

miniContext: She agreed to help with alacrity, dropping everything else she was doing.

examples.english: He felt ambivalent about moving abroad, excited yet afraid at the same time.
examples.persian: او دربارهٔ مهاجرت به خارج احساسات دوگانه داشت؛ هم هیجان‌زده بود و هم همزمان می‌ترسید.

miniContext: He felt ambivalent about moving abroad, excited yet afraid at the same time.

examples.english: Using a typewriter in a modern office feels anachronistic.
examples.persian: استفاده از ماشین تحریر در یک دفتر مدرن ناسازگار با زمان خود به نظر می‌رسد.

miniContext: Using a typewriter in a modern office feels anachronistic.

examples.english: He didn't mean to antagonize his coworkers, but his blunt comments often did.
examples.persian: او قصد نداشت همکارانش را تحریک کند، اما نظرات صریح او اغلب این‌گونه اثر می‌گذاشت.

miniContext: He didn't mean to antagonize his coworkers, but his blunt comments often did.

examples.english: Many young voters seemed apathetic about the local election.
examples.persian: بسیاری از رأی‌دهندگان جوان نسبت به انتخابات محلی بی‌تفاوت به نظر می‌رسیدند.

miniContext: Many young voters seemed apathetic about the local election.

examples.english: She has been an ardent supporter of the charity since its founding.
examples.persian: او از زمان تأسیس این خیریه، حامی پرحرارت و مشتاق آن بوده است.

miniContext: She has been an ardent supporter of the charity since its founding.

examples.english: Through assiduous practice, she mastered the violin within three years.
examples.persian: او از طریق تمرین کوشا و پیگیر، در عرض سه سال بر ویولن تسلط یافت.

miniContext: Through assiduous practice, she mastered the violin within three years.

examples.english: The startup made an audacious bid to compete with industry giants.
examples.persian: آن استارتاپ پیشنهادی جسور و بی‌باک برای رقابت با غول‌های صنعت ارائه داد.

miniContext: The startup made an audacious bid to compete with industry giants.

examples.english: The monk lived an austere life with no furniture beyond a bed and a desk.
examples.persian: آن راهب زندگی ساده و سخت‌گیرانه‌ای داشت و جز یک تخت و یک میز، وسیله‌ای نداشت.

miniContext: The monk lived an austere life with no furniture beyond a bed and a desk.

examples.english: He has a strong aversion to crowded places and avoids concerts entirely.
examples.persian: او بیزاری شدیدی نسبت به مکان‌های پرازدحام دارد و کاملاً از کنسرت‌ها دوری می‌کند.

miniContext: He has a strong aversion to crowded places and avoids concerts entirely.

examples.english: The customer became belligerent when the waiter brought the wrong order.
examples.persian: وقتی پیشخدمت سفارش اشتباه را آورد، مشتری ستیزه‌جو شد.

miniContext: The customer became belligerent when the waiter brought the wrong order.

examples.english: The benevolent donor paid for the entire school's new library.
examples.persian: آن اهداکننده خیرخواه هزینه کتابخانه جدید کل مدرسه را پرداخت کرد.

miniContext: The benevolent donor paid for the entire school's new library.

examples.english: Extra training sessions helped bolster the team's confidence before the final.
examples.persian: جلسات تمرین اضافی به تقویت اعتمادبه‌نفس تیم پیش از فینال کمک کرد.

miniContext: Extra training sessions helped bolster the team's confidence before the final.

examples.english: The thief made a brazen attempt to steal the painting in broad daylight.
examples.persian: دزد تلاشی بی‌شرمانه و گستاخ کرد تا نقاشی را در روز روشن بدزدد.

miniContext: The thief made a brazen attempt to steal the painting in broad daylight.

examples.english: The editor praised the article for its brevity and clarity.
examples.persian: ویراستار از این مقاله به خاطر کوتاهی و اختصار و وضوح آن تقدیر کرد.

miniContext: The editor praised the article for its brevity and clarity.

examples.english: She tried to cajole her little brother into sharing his dessert.
examples.persian: او سعی کرد برادر کوچکش را با چاپلوسی متقاعد کند که دسرش را با او شریک شود.

miniContext: She tried to cajole her little brother into sharing his dessert.

examples.english: The weather in the mountains is capricious, changing from sun to snow within hours.
examples.persian: آب‌وهوای کوهستان دمدمی‌مزاج است و در عرض چند ساعت از آفتاب به برف تغییر می‌کند.

miniContext: The weather in the mountains is capricious, changing from sun to snow within hours.

examples.english: The committee voted to censure the senator for his misleading statements.
examples.persian: کمیته رأی داد که سناتور را به خاطر بیانیه‌های گمراه‌کننده‌اش سرزنش کند.

miniContext: The committee voted to censure the senator for his misleading statements.

examples.english: No employee should be coerced into working unpaid overtime.
examples.persian: هیچ کارمندی نباید مجبور شود بدون دستمزد اضافه‌کاری کند.

miniContext: No employee should be coerced into working unpaid overtime.

examples.english: Her cogent argument convinced even the harshest critics on the panel.
examples.persian: استدلال قانع‌کننده و منطقی او حتی سخت‌گیرترین منتقدان هیئت را هم قانع کرد.

miniContext: Her cogent argument convinced even the harshest critics on the panel.
